about: Phase 2 V0.3 preregistration, machine-readable. Frozen with docs/phase2/v0.3-preregistration.md; read by the V1.5 report. It holds no third-party values: targets are referenced by local path and SHA-256.

error_model.primary: independent Gaussian errors, sigma as printed, at its printed scale
error_model.secondary_descriptive: standard errors scaled by sqrt(chi2/nu) when nu > 0

geometry.source: J. Gauss and J. F. Stanton, J. Phys. Chem. A 104, 2865-2868 (2000), r_e
geometry.shape: planar regular hexagon, each C-H bond radial; substituents ignored (no H-X pairs)

benzene-taggar2006.frame: z normal to the ring (the V1 D6h frame and the paper's)

targets.source: Taggar et al. (2006), Tables 1-2, S_zz with its printed uncertainty

odcb-chandrakumar1993.atoms: H1-H4 on consecutive ring carbons 3-6; Cl on carbons 1-2
odcb-chandrakumar1993.frame: the paper's: z normal to the ring, y the in-plane C2 axis, x parallel to H2-H3

conversion.where: a = S_zz and c = S_xx - S_yy in the V1 C2v frame

targets.source: Chandrakumar & Burnell (1993), Fig. 3 (filled markers), cross-checked against Fig. 2

flags.transcription: two identical AI transcriptions; the owner's spot-check pending

independent.label: independent support (declared geometry)
independent.p: the target's precision: its printed sigma (table) or digitization precision (figure)

reproduction.label: reproduction (the authors' geometry and objective)
reproduction.status: pending until the authors' geometries are obtained
reproduction.table: |S - S_pub| <= max(printed sigma, half a unit in the last printed digit)

dataset_label.experimentally supported: every compared target agrees, with the count of pending targets stated
dataset_label.unresolved failure: any compared target disagrees and has no reviewed README entry
dataset_label.explained discrepancy: a disagreement with a reviewed README entry; not counted as validation

sensitivity.odcb_near_duplicate: the dataset label is recomputed without II/300 and without II/302; a change is reported as fragile
